method: Direct view_image inspection of all four final run-02 PNGs at original resolution.

images.observation: One-turn reference, matched hand/load tracks and larger readings are clear. Two-column task values fit. Separate named cards distinguish 250 J of work from 50 W of power, with appropriate draft guidance and practice/continue actions.

At 320px in dark mode, the screw work card retains all torque, angle and joule values. The complete 1.98944 N·m times 628.319 rad calculation, explanation and continuation action fit without clipping.
At 320px with forced colors, the windlass work card and equation boundaries remain visible. The full 50 N·m times 5 rad equals 250 J expression and Continue work practice action are legible.

At 320px with doubled HTML guide text, the screw work card expands vertically. The complete operands, units, 1250 J result, guidance and action wrap without clipping; enlargement remains after React interactions.

limits: Desktop screenshot includes the complete rotation guide; phone screenshots crop the new torque-work card. Native assertions inspect both calculation cards and all eight original readings in every rotary scenario.
Enlarged text doubles computed HTML font sizes inside the guide rather than browser zoom; the static SVG reference text is unchanged.
Native harness uses real React, THREE and the host module with software WebGL. Production source was unchanged throughout both attempts.
